class.name: HealthComponent
class.brief_description: Health and damage system for any object.
class.description: Keeps track of the health of a character, enemy or object. Call [method damage] and [method heal], and connect to [signal died] to react when it reaches zero. After taking damage it can be invulnerable for [member invulnerability_time] seconds.

method.name: damage
method.description: Subtracts [param amount] from the health and returns the damage actually dealt. Does nothing while dead or invulnerable.

method.name: get_health_ratio
method.description: Returns the health divided by [member max_health], from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code]. Useful for health bars.

method.name: heal
method.description: Adds [param amount] to the health (up to [member max_health]) and returns the amount actually healed. Does nothing while dead.

method.name: is_invulnerability_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [member invulnerable] is enabled or the invulnerability after the last hit is still active.

method.name: kill
method.description: Sets the health to [code]0[/code], emitting [signal died].

method.name: revive
method.description: Brings the object back to life with [param health], or [member max_health] if it's negative.

members.member: Seconds of invulnerability after taking damage.

signal.name: damaged
signal.description: Emitted after taking damage, with the damage actually dealt.

signal.name: healed
signal.description: Emitted after healing, with the amount actually healed.
